sections.title: P4.4 validation evidence supplied to independent reviewer
sections.text:
Stable candidate: `0dce16cad7b1aab7506c60f2082f4f01c7313938b2ba2099d3dce9702783a5da`.
All 12 declared checks completed with exit 0; before/after bytes are identical.
Every run has a separate numbered JSON inventory and log; checks.json maps each
normative carrier to its actual command and proof. Contract pre_final allows the
recorded aggregate E21 receipt; concrete inventories additionally bind braced/glob
Files declarations and every dependency in the tested product tree.

- Database + RegressionSpecs: 102 tests, 704 assertions.
- Engines: PostgreSQL 11/193; MySQL 11/193; MariaDB 11/249; no skipped tests.
- Arch: 72 tests, 314 assertions.
- Full composer test: 2212 tests, 243535 assertions.
- API manifest check, Pint, PHPStan (0 errors), diff check: exit 0.
- Type coverage: 99.7%, threshold 98%.

Runtime: PHP 8.4.1; isolated SQLite :memory: and server azguard_test databases.
Explicit host test ports 25432/23306/23307, healthy Docker services. Type coverage
uses __PEST_PLUGIN_ENV=1/no-cache to keep the process/runtime witness reproducible.
PHPStan optional turbo-ext emits a dynamic-loading warning; normal analysis
completed with zero errors. No warning is represented as a loaded accelerator.
Composer lock and exact relevant vendor files are bound in the review manifest.

Review scope: all current P4.4 changed/new/deleted product files, required norms
and dependency closure. Dynamic overlay P4.17, scoped/P08 integration P4.18,
write/apply P5.2/P5.3, authority transaction protocol P4.20 and real race P4.21 are
explicit remaining owning obligations, not current GREEN claims.
